agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Coppertop lost two turns to sleep while Sunflora recovered with Leech Seed; staying in remained minimax because every replacement failed the verified critical entry-survival bound.
Lildozer, Croakatoa, and Coppertop fainted after making progress; three survivors still completed the fight reliably.
Sleep and a fourth Razor Leaf increased the line from 23 to 25 actions; no extra switch was introduced.

correct_choices: Only two switches were voluntary: Lildozer into Ponyta and Coppertop into Sunflora; both entered safely and attacked.
Croakatoa and Bushtank entered only after forced faints and made immediate progress.
Coppertop stayed through sleep because Birdlaw, Ohmnomnom, and Bushtank were all unsafe voluntary entries.
Birdlaw entered only after Coppertop fainted and then finished Sunflora and Dustox without switching.
All 25 actions, including both sleep-prevented turns, matched authoritative state.
agent_review.next_test: Run Clone 3 with identical behavior and require a third reviewed win with no no-action voluntary switch or action-changing defect.
